items.t: Morgan Stanley Ends Anthropic Stock Support After Just One Day
items.sum: Morgan Stanley closed Anthropic’s price support after one day as ANT stock slid toward its $83 IPO price. Will the stock hold?

items.t: Coinbase falls below Morgan Stanley’s $120 target
items.sum: The Coinbase stock took about two weeks to fall below the bank’s $120 target as crypto trading dries up.

items.t: Morgan Stanley (MS) Debuts Four Active UCITS ETFs In Europe
items.sum: Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) has launched an active ETF platform in Europe using four Ireland domiciled UCITS ETFs. The new range focuses on long term thematic and actively managed strategies aimed at investors outside the U.S. The ETFs are registered under Irish UCITS rules, giving passporting access to multiple European markets.
